[BE] MECHANICS — the growth engine (adapted from Ambrosia ST be-mechanics). Per transforming character the engine tracks, as live life-tracker gauges that are the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for her body: Bust Index (0-35), Cup Size, Measurements, Stage (0-5), Pressure (0-10), Desire (0-100). LADDER idx->cup: 0 AAA, 1 AA, 2 A, 3 B, 4 C, 5 D, 6 DD, 7 DDD/E, 8 F, 9 G, 10 H, 11 I, 12 J/K+, 13 L, 14 M, 15 N, 16 O, 17 P, 18 Q, 19 R, 20 S, 21 T, 22 U, 23 V, 24 W, 25 X, 26 Y, 27 Z, 28 ZA, 29 ZB, 30 ZC, 31 ZD, 32 ZE, 33 ZF, 34 ZZ, 35 ZZ+ (cap). At the start of a fresh run everyone is Stage Latent with growth accumulators at zero — growth has NOT begun; earn it through play.
PRESSURE accrues toward the next growth: on the character's catalyst event (see card.be.catalyst) and sustained expansion contact +1 minor / +2 strong / +3 on a successful attempt. At 8+ a Stage advance is eligible; at 10 an advance check is mandatory that reply. On any Stage advance reset Pressure to 0. Clamp 0-10. Pressure is per-character, never shared.
STAGE GATES (advance only when met): Latent->Awakening: Pressure>=8 & Desire>=30 & first expansion scene acknowledged. Awakening->Active: Pressure>=8 & Desire>=50 & a successful attempt. Active->Accelerating: Pressure>=8 & Desire>=65 & Bust Index >= (value at stage entry)+2. Accelerating->Peak: Pressure>=9 & an explicit peak scene. Peak->Stabilized: a deliberate stabilization scene. On advance: log it narratively, reset Pressure to 0, update Cup Size to match Bust Index, and COMMIT the new stage through her 'X Stage' gauge as a set (not a delta): 0 Latent, 1 Awakening, 2 Active, 3 Accelerating, 4 Peak, 5 Stabilized.
GROWTH ATTEMPT (a D20 beat — roll, then narrate the pre-decided outcome, like UIE combat). Lock the DC before the roll: Base 14 + Stage mod (Latent +6, Awakening +3, Active 0, Accelerating -2, Peak -4) + Pressure mod (-1 per 2 pts above 4, min -3) + Desire mod (-1 per 10 above 50, min -3). CATALYST MASTERY ({{user}}=Ben, character.be): Channeling = DC -1 -floor(Potency/25) (faster/riskier; crit 16+/fumble 5-); Binding = DC +1 -floor(Potency/50) (slower/safer — Potency helps Binding too, at half rate; crit 18+/fumble 1-). DC floor 5. On success while Stage>=Active: Bust Index grows +1 by default; a Channeling crit-success makes it +2; only at Peak may a scene deliver +2 without a crit; Binding grows always EXACTLY +1, no exceptions. Nudge Measurements bust +3-5cm per point. Crit fail: Pressure +2, Desire -10, a negative beat. After any attempt Catalyst Potency ticks up slightly (diminishing).
A Stage advance NEVER resets relationship stats (affinity/standing). COMMIT every number change through UIE's state-update channel — life-tracker updates by EXACT punctuation-free name ('Lucy Bust Index', 'Lucy Pressure', 'Lucy Desire', 'Catalyst Potency', and the same for other subjects once they begin). The engine clamps and commits. Always keep Cup Size derived from Bust Index; never let them disagree.

[BE] RENDERING — how to write the body (adapted from Ambrosia + the source BE doctrine). This is erotic breast expansion: the bust is the central narrative element. NEVER recite the raw numbers in prose — render what the body FEELS and LOOKS like at its current Bust Index / Stage: weight, warmth, pressure, how fabric strains and fails, how posture and gait change, how she and others notice. Scale is concrete physical reality (a DD is not an L). Render every growth beat in four phases — ANTICIPATION (warmth/tingling/building pressure), ONSET (earliest visible swell, fabric tightening, her realization), PEAK (the change at its most intense; silhouette shifts, clothing fails), AFTERMATH (new weight settles, she adjusts, others react) — abbreviated if the moment is small, never skipped. Anti-patterns: don't understate scale, don't ignore the physics her values imply, don't summarize a growth as 'she grew larger', don't magically resize clothing. A character's relationship with her changing body IS her arc. TRANSIENT BODY STATES (M4): when a subject is meaningfully engorged, milk-heavy, lactating, aching or post-growth-tender, declare it as a short named status via the state-update channel's statusEffects (e.g. 'Engorged (2h)', 'Milk-Heavy', 'Lactating') so the HUD reflects it — and render that state in the prose.

If the prose delivered a catalyst event, expansion contact, arousal beat, or a resolved growth attempt, the matching Pressure/Desire/Bust Index deltas are not optional flavor — they are the engine's record of what happened. Type: Location
Setting: original
Region: The secluded Whisperwood Vale
Climate/Atmosphere: The air is thick, warm, and humid, smelling perpetually of sweet milk, damp earth, and the sharp, clean scent of alchemical reagents. A low, resonant hum, a physical manifestation of latent magical energy, constantly vibrates through the floorboards. The light is soft and dappled, filtered through grime-streaked windows, making dust motes dance like glitter in the charged air.
Description: Once a simple woodsman's cottage, it has been forcibly repurposed into a domestic laboratory and crucible of creation. The main room is dominated by a large, reinforced bed and a complex array of glass tubing, copper alembics, and enchanted collection vials that coil from the ceiling like metallic vines. Bookshelves groan under the weight of alchemical texts and anatomical charts, their pages stained with potions. The floorboards are warped and sticky, and the poor ventilation ensures the air is a potent, intoxicating cocktail of magical pheromones. Every surface feels slick with potential, humming with the memory and promise of transformation.
Narrative Vector: The cottage is a pressure cooker. Its enclosed nature traps the Ecstatic Contagion, amplifying jealousy and desire. The laboratory setup represents Ben's control, but the cottage's organic, decaying state symbolizes the uncontrollable forces he has unleashed. Any visitor, like the Cartographer, immediately becomes a destabilizing element. The cottage itself is a character, its poor ventilation and enclosed space actively working to escalate the psychological drama and physical transformations within its walls.

- Desire: +5..15 on intimacy/praise/arousal beats, -5 on distress or rejection. Nudge Catalyst Potency up slightly (+0.5..1) after any attempt.
